article.title: Brent crude climbs to a five-month high on tightening OPEC+ supply
article.text: Brent crude settled at a five-month high after OPEC+ signalled it would hold production cuts through the next quarter, tightening global supply as demand stayed resilient.
article.note: A crude-price headline that never mentions tyre makers. The tyre_input_cost archetype (crude-linked synthetic rubber and carbon black) correctly surfaces MRF as a real, governed second-order company -- distance 2, INDIRECT directness, tier D (curated registry) -- so it must publish as secondary_ripple, never primary.
